notes.title: Thank You for Your Time Releases with 42 Wishlisters!
notes.content:
Hi guys, I'm Alex - aka Rogue Writer Indie! 

I just wanted to say a quick thank you to my 42 pre-release wishlisters and everyone else who decides to check out my game. It means a lot! 

Thank You for Your Time is free, but if you want to support me, the best way to do so is to leave a short review.

Have fun, choose wisely, and good luck out there!
